title: T2 capture times that quantize to tick 0 or past the last tick are silently never captured — no golden is compared or written and the demo still passes
detail: cap_tick floors to 0 for cap_ms < 1000/hz and exceeds ticks past run_ms; the exact-equality with a loop that starts at tick 1 never fires, so the golden is silently skipped in both run and save mode — no failure surfaces.
recommended_fix: In parse_demo, validate each capture time quantizes into [1, demo_run_ticks], or fail the run when a capture never fires.

title: Draw intents with at_ms beyond run_ms become dead log records that never apply — the blessed log and the replay gate silently accept them
detail: lower_intents never checks apply_tick <= ticks: a draw past run_ms is written to the log but never applied live or in replay, so hashes still match and the gate blesses the dead record — a demo-authoring error tolerated silently.
recommended_fix: Validate at_ms <= run_ms in parse_demo (reject or clamp), so an intent can never lower to a record outside the run's tick window.

title: catalogs_load requires residential+router_basic but not content_host or the 'standard' tier; the app's fixture/tier lookups discard the ok flag and silently fall back to index 0
detail: A catalog dropping content_host or 'standard' passes catalogs_load; the app then silently spawns a residential-typed node at the host position and draws with tier 0 — wrong fixture and cost with no error.
recommended_fix: Add content_host and 'standard' to the catalogs_load required-content cross-checks, and fail loudly when the app's fixture or tier lookup misses.

title: dist2 computes the i32 delta before widening to i64 — node coordinates spanning >= 2^31 wrap, silently corrupting the pinned distance metric
detail: a[0]-b[0] wraps in i32 before the cast: verified dist2({2147483647,0},{-2147483648,0}) returns 1 (not 4294967295^2), and the square-sum overflows i64 for large deltas — arch §6.1's 'exact, identical on every target' metric silently corrupts.
recommended_fix: Widen before subtracting: dx := i64(a[0]) - i64(b[0]) (same for dy), and bound node-position range so dx*dx + dy*dy stays below 2^63.

title: jint narrows JSON integers to i32 with unchecked wraparound — an out-of-range catalog value can wrap into a legal value and pass validation
detail: json.Integer is i64; i32(x) wraps (verified i32(4294967301) == 5), and the validations only check signs — a max_span of 2^32+5 silently becomes a legal max_span 5 instead of a named rejection.
recommended_fix: Range-check catalog numerics against i32 bounds before the narrowing cast (or store i64 and validate in i64), e.g. reject values outside 0..i32.max.

title: drift-check's truncation mutation passes len(src)-1 to make — a 0-byte blessed log aborts the run instead of getting a clean rejection
evidence:
trunc := make([dynamic]u8, len(src)-1, context.temp_allocator)
copy(trunc[:], src[:len(src)-1])
detail: For a 0-byte log, len(src)-1 = -1: verified the Odin runtime aborts with 'Invalid dynamic array parameters for make: -1:-1'. The other mutations guard on len(src) > N, but the truncation mutation is unconditional — a crash, not the defined rejection.
recommended_fix: Guard the truncation mutation like the others (skip when len(src) == 0), or treat an empty log as corrupt-rejected without mutating.
